revise_description: The objective is transformed from minimizing the shortfall of Priority 3 to maximizing the total number of recruits who simultaneously satisfy both their preferred specialty and preferred city, while still enforcing Priority 1 and Priority 2 as hard requirements. This reflects a new HR policy that emphasizes dual-match placement quality after mandatory staffing and specialty satisfaction are secured.
